alt: A bot in an ELU session: @reviewer is added to a new session, reviews the agent's change under its own name, asks for one fix, and passes the change once it is fixed.

frames.caption: You add the bot @reviewer to a new session.
It will review each change. You ask for one.
You approve the Task. Opus makes the change.
@reviewer finds one thing to fix. Opus works on it.
Opus fixed it. @reviewer reviews again: Passed.
